item.title: Game Theoretical Models and Applications SING21
item.content:encoded:
Annamaria Barbagallo, University of Naples Federico II

Encarnación Algaba, University of Seville

Giovanna Bimonte, University of Salerno

Francesco Ciardiello, University of Salerno

This special issue focuses on game theory as a framework for studying strategic behavior, cooperation, and decision-making in complex systems. It welcomes research on both theoretical developments and practical applications across diverse fields, with emphasis on interaction dynamics and collective decision-making.

The issue particularly encourages submissions from participants of the European Meeting on Game Theory 2026 (SING21), who are invited to submit expanded versions of their conference papers. Other submissions in game theory and related applications are also welcome.

Appel publié par Annals of Operations Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Cooperative games and their applications
  • Non-cooperative games and strategic interaction
  • Mechanism design
  • Network
  • Dynamic games
  • Evolutionary games
  • Stochastic games
  • Voting, power indices, and collective decision-making
  • Auctions and market design
  • Bargaining
  • Learning and experimentation in games
  • Computational game theory
  • Applications to management and energy
  • Applications to health policy and industrial organization
  • Applications to environmental and resource economics
  • Applications to transportation, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence

Timeline

  • April 20, 2027: Submission deadline
